chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadala from Aban from Shihab ibn 'Abd Rabbih and 'Abdullah ibn Sinan, both of them from al-Walid ibn Sabih from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The Ta'qib is more effective in seeking sustenance than traveling through lands." He means by Ta'qib the supplication after the prayer.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of reciting Ta'qib after prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the spiritual efficacy of post-prayer supplications (Ta'qib) as a primary means of securing divine sustenance (rizq), surpassing the physical effort of traveling in search of livelihood. This teaching underscores the Shia emphasis on the transformative power of consistent, intimate communion with God immediately after the obligatory prayer, linking ritual devotion directly to material and spiritual provision.
